chapter_note: Heavily damaged chapter (86.5% damage). Opens mid-teaching with the second ploughed-field (the living soul in the upper Zone, with two great luminaries as farmers) — this opening is cosmological substrate. The third ploughed-field is then identified explicitly with the Holy Church (elect + catechumens) — a clear editorial extension applying the three-earths schema to the Manichaean institution. The chapter closes with a long hortatory exhortation to the audience to 'become beautiful farmers' and proclaim. Editorial fatigue score is sharply negative because the entire substrate teaching of the FIRST earth (and presumably the substrate frame of the second) has been lost to damage; what survives is the ecclesial application + hortatory tail. The Mind of Light (ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲥ ⲛ̄ⲟⲩⲁ̄ⲓⲛⲉ) is a cosmic figure but here functions as patron of the institutional church.
